philosophy.title: Stylesheets are architecture
philosophy.body: A resilient stylesheet survives the next six people who touch it. That is a design decision, not a cleanup task.

philosophy.title: Accessibility is the baseline
philosophy.body: WCAG is where a build starts, not an audit that happens near launch.

philosophy.title: Motion carries meaning
philosophy.body: Animation should explain what changed. If it cannot be turned off gracefully, it was not finished.

intro: My interest in the web started in high school, messing around on Geocities. I pursued graphic design, earned a BFA from Missouri State, and spent years doing print and identity work while building websites as part of that work along the way. Eventually I found I was enjoying the web work more, and pivoted to focus on development full time so I could go deeper.

For over a decade I led front-end at Marlin Connections, building user-facing features for products in the food-service industry. Alongside that, I spent eight semesters teaching design students at Missouri State, from graphic design to basic web coding.

education.degree: Bachelor of Fine Arts in Graphic Design, Cum Laude

jobs.body: Developing custom websites and applications for agencies and direct clients.

jobs.role: Senior Web Developer and Front-end Team Leader
jobs.body: Led front-end development for web products serving the food-service industry. Worked closely with designers and developers to build user-facing features that balanced good UX with sound technical decisions. Guided front-end standards and helped set direction for the team.

Taught five courses for design students at the sophomore through senior level, covering design software, production, graphic design concepts, and web design and development. All courses were project-based. Responsible for curriculum structure, instruction, and assessment within a defined range of topics.

Designed and developed print and web projects for local and regional clients across a range of industries. Owned the full lifecycle of client websites from concept through launch, including hosting and ongoing maintenance.
Led design across a wide range of print and web projects, including a quarterly magazine. Assigned work to and directed other designers and interns.
